description: This file defines the BatchDelete class which manages batch deletion of objects from an Amazon S3 bucket, utilizing AWS SDK and Guzzle promises. It includes static factory methods for creating batch delete objects based on list results or custom iterators, handles promise creation and execution, and manages batch queueing with configurable batch sizes.

classes.name: BatchDelete
classes.description: A class for batching and asynchronously deleting multiple objects from an S3 bucket using the AWS SDK and promises, with support for custom pre-processing and batch sizing.

methods.name: fromListObjects
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete instance configured to delete objects from a list obtained via a paginator from ListObjects API results.

methods.name: fromIterator
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete instance that enqueues objects from a provided iterator for deletion.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all delete operations are completed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Forces synchronous deletion of all queued objects by waiting on the promise.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the BatchDelete instance with an AWS client, bucket name, promise factory, and options such as batch size and callback.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds an object to the queue and triggers batch flush if queue size exceeds batch size.

methods.name: flushQueue
methods.description: Processes the current batch of queued objects and sends a delete command to S3.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Creates and returns a promise to perform the batch delete operations, including cleanup after completion.
